result.topic_en: Gauss transforms the integral of the moment (yX - xY) dm of electrodynamic forces exerted by a closed current element sum into line-sum (S) expressions over the current path, and gives a similar expression for the integral of X dm.
result.transcription:
$\int (yX - xY)\,dm = S.\,V dc$
[-$+S\,\xi a dc$-]
$+S(\xi a + \eta b + \zeta c)dc$
$-S\,\zeta(a da + b db + c dc)$
$+S\,c(\xi da + \eta db + \zeta dc)$
$-\int z S\,\frac{(x-a)da + (y-b)db + (z-c)dc}{r^3}\,dm$

$= S V dc$
$+ S\{\xi(a dc + c da) + \eta(b dc + c db) + \zeta(c dc - a da - b db)\}$
$- \int z S\,\frac{d\frac{1}{r}}{ds}.\,ds$
Der zweite Theil auch [?] $= S\{(\xi c - \zeta a)da + (\eta c - \zeta b)db + (a\xi + b\eta + c\zeta)dc\}$

[-$\int X dm\ S$-]
$\int X dm = S(\eta dc - \zeta db)$

methods.what: Expression of the integrated torque about the z-axis as a sum of line sums over the current element coordinates (a,b,c) with components xi, eta, zeta
Combination of the line-sum terms into a single bracket, and rewriting the last integral via the derivative of 1/r along the path
methods.quote: $+ S\{\xi(a dc + c da) + \eta(b dc + c db) + \zeta(c dc - a da - b db)\}$

methods.what: Recognition of the integrand as a total derivative of 1/r
Alternative form of the second part
methods.quote: Der zweite Theil auch [?] $= S\{(\xi c - \zeta a)da + (\eta c - \zeta b)db + (a\xi + b\eta + c\zeta)dc\}$
